resources.string: A gentler ringtone when you need it.
SoftRing is off. Turn it on below.
Start and end must be different.
On vibrate or silent, the volume is not changed.
To lower the volume during a mode

While a mode is on (Bedtime, Do Not Disturb…), Android lets only apps with “Do Not Disturb access” change the volume. SoftRing uses it only for the volume: it does not read or change your modes. If you do not use modes, you can do without it.
Without the “Alarms & reminders” permission, Android may delay the volume change, sometimes by a long time.
Without the “Alarms & reminders” permission, from Android 17 SoftRing cannot change the volume while the app is closed: during your hours the volume would stay as it is.
SoftRing follows these hours, not your Android modes (Do Not Disturb, Bedtime…). Set them to match the mode you use (for sleep, at work…).
Always, until you turn SoftRing off
Volume lowered until you turn SoftRing off.
When you release a slider, you hear how it will sound.
The volume preview needs Android 9 or later.
It is at %1$d now: SoftRing never raises the volume, it will stay at %1$d.
Phone on vibrate or silent: no preview.
SoftRing lowers the ringtone and notification volume during the hours you choose, or always, and at the end puts the previous volumes back.
It follows its own hours, not your Android modes (Do Not Disturb, Bedtime…). If a mode lets calls ring, SoftRing still lowers the volume.
Vibrate and silent: if the phone is on vibrate or silent, it stays that way, and when the sound comes back SoftRing puts the right volumes back within 15 minutes, or at once if you open the app.
It never raises the volume: if the daytime volume is already lower than the lowered one, it stays as it is.

SoftRing does not keep running: Android starts it only for an instant when the volume has to change, usually twice a day. You do not need to keep the app open or remove it from battery optimization: you can close it (but not with “Force stop”), SoftRing keeps working.

No internet access, no data collection, no ads or trackers. No access to the microphone, camera, location, contacts, phone, messages, files or any other personal data: it does not know who is calling and does not read your notifications. Settings are excluded from backups and phone-to-phone transfers.
Do Not Disturb access: to change the volume while a mode is on.
Alarms & reminders: to change the volume at the exact time.
Run at startup: to apply your hours again after the phone restarts.
Foreground service: from Android 17, for an instant at each volume change.
